name: Elvira 2 XL
notes: Elmyra 2 controls with eleven MODP programs, twelve filter types, microtonal scales, effects, two LFOs and patch jacks. BITMANGLER uses 16-bit XOR; the original's exact mask sequence is unverified. Missing: outside audio, control-motion recording and the full 128-step TUNE sequencer. The sequence here has eight steps. Browser only.
